shape.means: square corners, a solid base; rules, institutions, structure
edges that bulge slightly, no two alike; living things, people, growth
soft, generous corners; friendly and calm

label.means: a tilted double-ruled stamp, inked, no fill
a luggage tag tied to the part with a curved string
plain words with a thick coloured underline that runs into a leader

bubble.means: a sticky note taped up, tilted, with a folded corner
a scalloped cloud with trailing puffs
a rounded speech bubble with a curved tail (the classic)

panel.means: no fill: a double hairline with corner brackets, the title set into the rule
no box at all: a short accent bar above the title, content on the ground
a filled card in the lesson's shape language (the classic)

icon.means: a rosette seal, icon knocked out
the icon alone, heavier, standing on a soft ground shadow
the icon knocked out of a coloured disc (the classic)

mark.means: a tilted double-ringed stamp around the mark
a thick tapered brush stroke, no container
tick or cross knocked out of a disc (the classic)

entrance.means: things drop in and land, panels settle
things pop in with a little overshoot (the classic)
things are drawn or wiped on, as if by hand

camera.means: cuts between held frames (guidance for the storyboard)
the camera pushes into the part that matters (guidance for the storyboard)
